description:
Add the optimized modem path for Gray-coded square QAM, including QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, and 256-QAM. This story delivers the high-performance path needed for common BICM and DVB-T2 workflows.

## Background

Arbitrary-constellation support is necessary for ergonomics, but the common square-QAM family should not pay the full generic cost. The optimized path should exploit Gray-PAM structure, precomputed tables, and batch-friendly memory layout while remaining API-compatible with the generic modem surface.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public preset constructors exist for Gray-coded QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, and 256-QAM and use the same labeling and normalization metadata as the shared modem builder.
- [ ] The preset-backed modem path selects a specialized Gray square-QAM demapper through the shared modem API rather than through a separate public interface.
- [ ] The Gray-QAM hot path uses caller-provided output buffers and avoids per-symbol heap allocation in the demapper loop.
- [ ] Fast-path demapper outputs match the reference modem path for the supported demapper modes on representative AWGN cases, and benchmark coverage reports the relevant throughput-critical loops.

## Notes

This story is the performance-critical core of the epic and should be designed to support SIMD acceleration cleanly.
title: Implement optimized Gray square-QAM mapper and demapper
